comments.text: The Chicxulub part was the standout for me — a roughly 15 km-wide asteroid hitting at about 20 km per second and leaving a 150 km crater, wiping out around 75% of species. I also loved the contrast that Yucatán has almost no surface rivers because the rainwater dissolves straight through the limestone into underground streams and cenotes.
